ITEM 1 | Charred, halved or whole small green cup-shaped vegetable pieces, dark brown-black blistered edges on several, bright green interiors, slightly glossy, firm, clustered in the upper-left quadrant of the plate spanning about 9 x 8 cm | 140
ITEM 2 | Pale beige grainy mixture with flecks of bright green herb and pinkish-orange pieces, moist and clumped, mounded in the upper-right area spanning about 7 x 6 cm, about 2.5 cm tall | 150
ITEM 3 | Flaky pinkish-orange fish piece with visible flake lines, moist and soft, sitting at the right edge of the grain mound, about 5 x 3 cm, about 1.5 cm thick | 60
ITEM 4 | Long thin dark green leafy strand, flat and ruffled, lying along the right edge beside the fish, about 6 x 1.5 cm | 8
ITEM 5 | Lower-left mixed pile of shredded pale cabbage-like strands, thin bright green green beans cut into short pieces, small cubes of pale tan and white food, a few thin yellow curled slices, and a small purple-tinged strand, glossy with light oil, spread across about 12 x 10 cm and about 2 cm tall | 110
ITEM 6 | Thin light green-yellow wilted leafy fragments and a few sprigs scattered among other items, about 4 x 3 cm total | 5
ITEM 7 | Light oil or moisture sheen on the plate surface with a few glistening drops around the vegetables, barely visible | 5
